data.desc: Oscar Insurance is one of the largest and fastest-growing health insurers dedicated to the individual market. Oscar serves millions of individuals across the country with innovative products and CHOICE Arrangement solutions (formerly ICHRA) tailored to their life stages, health needs, and budgets. Oscar's technology-powered experiences make high-quality care easy to use and feel personal. Oscar is part of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR). Learn more at HiOscar.com.
